title: ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, State Street Investment Management
description:
Who we are looking for

 

The ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, is part of the Global ETF Research team. The role is responsible for developing and delivering customized portfolio analytics that help clients understand how portfolios are constructed, where vulnerabilities may be present, and how different investment solutions can support specific portfolio objectives.

 

The position combines portfolio diagnostics, asset allocation research, analytical tool development, and client-specific investment analysis. It covers both proprietary and non-proprietary funds and evaluates products according to the role they may play within a broader portfolio.

The role has a specific focus on:

·         Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio construction insights,

·         Strategic and tactical asset allocation analysis across asset classes, regions, factors, and investment styles,

·         Assessment of portfolio vulnerabilities, including concentration, unintended exposures, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity considerations, and other sources of risk,

·         Evaluation of how proprietary and non-proprietary funds may serve different portfolio roles, such as core exposure, diversification, risk mitigation, income, liquidity management, or targeted return enhancement,

·         Development and maintenance of scalable analytical tools, methodologies, and client-ready portfolio diagnostics,

·         Leadership, quality oversight, and development of junior team members.

 

As an ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, you will work closely with ETF specialists, investment strategists, sales teams, and other stakeholders across the State Street Investment Management organization. You will translate complex portfolio findings into clear, commercially relevant insights and collaborate with marketing, product, and investment teams to support client engagement and business priorities.

The successful candidate will combine strong investment judgment with quantitative and communication skills. They will be able to move from portfolio-level diagnosis to practical asset allocation considerations, explain the interaction between holdings and exposures, and identify how individual funds can contribute to a coherent portfolio solution.

 

Why this role is important to us

 

The team you will join is part of State Street Investment Management, one of the world's largest asset managers, serving governments, institutions, and financial advisors globally. With more than four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer a broad range of investment solutions across asset classes, risk profiles, regions, and investment styles. As pioneers in index investing and ETFs, we continue to develop new ways to help investors build portfolios.

Clients increasingly need analysis that goes beyond selecting an individual fund. They need to understand how exposures interact at the portfolio level, whether diversification is effective, where risk may be concentrated, and which implementation choices are most appropriate for their objectives and constraints. High-quality portfolio analytics can turn fund-level data into actionable portfolio construction insights and is an important capability supporting the growth of our ETF business.

Join us if you are ready to make an immediate impact by helping clients identify portfolio vulnerabilities, evaluate asset allocation choices, and use investment products more effectively within complete portfolios.

What you will be responsible for

 

Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio diagnostics:

·         Lead the design and delivery of customized analyses for client portfolios, model portfolios, and strategic sales opportunities,

·         Assess portfolio structure across asset classes, regions, sectors, factors, currencies, investment styles, and underlying holdings,

·         Identify potential vulnerabilities, including concentration risk, overlapping exposures, unintended factor tilts, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity constraints, and dependence on individual market outcomes,

·         Apply scenario analysis, stress testing, risk decomposition, performance attribution, correlation analysis, and other relevant methods to explain portfolio behavior,

·         Translate analytical findings into clear observations, trade-offs, and implementation considerations for clients and internal stakeholders,

·         Produce the Portfolio Insights and Analysis output, providing an in-depth assessment of portfolio construction, areas of weakness, potential risk, and opportunities to improve portfolio resilience.

 

Asset allocation and portfolio construction strategies:

·         Evaluate strategic and tactical asset allocation approaches in the context of client objectives, investment horizons, risk tolerances, liquidity needs, and implementation constraints,

·         Analyze how changes in asset allocation may affect portfolio risk, return drivers, diversification, and sensitivity to market scenarios,

·         Develop analytical frameworks that connect macroeconomic and market views with portfolio exposures and possible implementation choices,

·         Assess the role of different building blocks within a total portfolio, including core beta, active, factor, fixed income, liquidity, income, alternatives, and risk-management exposures,

·         Support the development of portfolio construction methodologies, model-based analyses, and repeatable frameworks for common client use cases.

 

Fund roles and implementation analysis:

·         Evaluate both State Street and third-party funds according to their potential function within a portfolio,

·         Analyze how different funds may provide core exposure, diversification, downside mitigation, income, liquidity, inflation sensitivity, duration management, factor exposure, or targeted growth opportunities,

·         Assess implementation trade-offs using holdings, returns, risk, liquidity, portfolio fit, and other relevant characteristics,

·         Use competitive and market analysis selectively to frame available implementation choices and explain material differences between approaches,

·         Provide data and analysis for client requests, including holdings, return streams, portfolio characteristics, risk measures, exposure analysis, and other relevant outputs.

 

Analytical tool and methodology development:

·         Maintain and enhance existing portfolio analytics tools using in-house capabilities and third-party data or technology platforms,

·         Develop scalable tools that support both repeatable high-volume analysis and detailed bespoke work for significant commercial opportunities,

·         Create robust methodologies for portfolio diagnostics, vulnerability assessment, asset allocation analysis, fund-role classification, and implementation comparison,

·         Improve workflow efficiency, data quality, methodological consistency, and the clarity of client-ready outputs,

·         Evaluate relevant external analytical capabilities where they can strengthen portfolio analysis or improve the client experience.

 

Commercial and stakeholder support:

·         Partner with sales, ETF specialists, and investment strategists to understand client needs and define the most relevant analytical approach,

·         Design targeted portfolio analyses that support specific client conversations and commercial opportunities,

·         Serve as a subject matter expert for portfolio analytics, portfolio construction, asset allocation, and ETF-related RFPs and DDQs,

·         Present complex findings in a concise and accessible way for technical and non-technical audiences,

·         Collaborate with product, marketing, investment, and technology teams to align analytical capabilities with client needs and business priorities.

 

Leadership and quality oversight:

·         Train and develop junior team members in portfolio analytics, investment interpretation, tool usage, and communication of findings,

·         Allocate and prioritize work across the team, balancing recurring deliverables with bespoke client opportunities,

·         Review analytical outputs for methodological soundness, accuracy, relevance, and claritt,

·         Ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time,

·         Promote consistent analytical standards, documentation, and effective knowledge sharing.

 

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

·         Excellent quantitative, portfolio analysis, and investment interpretation skills,

·         Strong understanding of portfolio construction, asset allocation, diversification, risk decomposition, scenario analysis, and performance drivers,

·         Ability to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and distinguish material risks from less decision-relevant observations,

·         Ability to evaluate funds as portfolio building blocks and explain how different exposures may serve different investor objectives,

·         Experience designing analytical frameworks, automating processes, and developing scalable tools,

·         Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy when working under pressure,

·         Ability to prioritize work, exercise sound judgment, and meet tight deadlines,

·         Ability to communicate technical analysis clearly in writing, presentations, and client discussions,

·         Good understanding of the global ETF and fund landscape, investment implementation choices, and relevant distribution channels,

·         Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience extracting meaningful insights from large and complex data sets is essential,

·         Ability to guide less experienced team members and develop their analytical skills,

·         Collaborative, self-motivated, intellectually curious, and comfortable working independently,

 

Education and preferred qualifications

·         Bachelor's degree or equivalent; an advanced degree or relevant professional qualification is beneficial,

·         10+ years of experience in a financial institution or finance-related industry, with substantial exposure to portfolio analytics, asset allocation, investment research, or portfolio construction,

·         Strong written and spoken English.

 

Other beneficial skills

·         Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Morningstar, FactSet, or comparable investment analytics and data platforms,

·         Experience with ETFs, mutual funds, model portfolios, multi-asset portfolios, or institutional portfolio analysis,

·         Programming or data-handling skills relevant to scalable analytics,

·         Experience developing analytical solutions using AI or advanced automation tools,

·         Knowledge of investment risk, market structure, liquidity, and portfolio implementation considerations,

·         Awareness of current market and economic issues and their potential portfolio implications.

Minimum Salary:​

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.​

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.​

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.​

​

We Offer:​

title: Currency Management Portfolio Manager, Assistant Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for

State Street Currency Management is seeking a Currency Portfolio Manager to join our team in Sydney, Australia.

The Currency Portfolio Manager is central to the daily management and implementation of institutional client currency hedging strategies. The Portfolio Manager analyzes and monitors client portfolio exposures relative to current hedge positions across funds and share classes and is responsible for the end-to-end management of assigned client mandates.

The role requires a strong understanding of FX markets, portfolio management, risk and controls, and client servicing. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across our global Currency Management team to deliver consistent client outcomes and effective global coverage.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

As a Currency Portfolio Manager, you will:

Manage the daily implementation and oversight of currency hedging strategies for assigned institutional clients.

Monitor client portfolio exposures relative to current hedge positions and identify required rebalancing activity.

Ensure the completeness and accuracy of inbound client data, mandate compliance, portfolio calculations and client reporting.

Create and review FX orders, perform pre-trade due diligence and coordinate trade execution in accordance with client mandates.

Exercise sound judgment in managing client hedging programs, identifying potential data issues, mandate exceptions and operational risks, and escalating where appropriate.

Manage the full portfolio lifecycle, including rebalances and other client-directed or event-driven transactions.

Contribute to complex client events, including new client implementations, restructurings, and transitions

Perform post-trade review and ensure transactions and portfolio positions have been accurately reflected within Currency Management systems.

Monitor portfolio-level risks, including hedge ratios, currency exposures and client-specific mandate requirements.

Work closely with the global Currency Management team in Sydney, London and Boston to provide effective global coverage and seamless transition of responsibilities between regions.

Partner with trading colleagues on execution strategy, counterparty considerations and transaction-cost analysis where appropriate.

Participate in client due diligence meetings, service reviews, new-business presentations and ongoing client inquiries.

Contribute to enhancements to portfolio-management processes, controls, technology and monitoring capabilities.

Maintain a strong risk and control mindset, ensuring that portfolio-management activities are performed in accordance with established policies, procedures and client requirements.

Global Coverage: The role is based in Sydney, Australia and forms part of Currency Management's global portfolio-management coverage alongside colleagues in London and Boston.  The successful candidate must be comfortable managing responsibilities within a global operating model where client portfolios, instructions and issues may transition between regions. Clear communication, disciplined handovers, strong documentation and consistent adherence to portfolio-management controls are therefore critical to the role.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

Demonstrated experience in currency portfolio management, FX markets, portfolio implementation or a related institutional investment-management function.

Strong understanding of FX products, particularly spot, forwards and swaps.

Experience managing institutional client portfolios or implementing hedging strategies.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate portfolio exposures, hedge positions and transaction requirements.

Excellent attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to operate accurately within time-critical deadlines.

Sound judgment and the ability to identify unusual data, portfolio or trading activity and escalate appropriately.

Strong understanding of investment-management risk and control principles.

Ability to communicate effectively with institutional clients and internal stakeholders.

Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a global team.

Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to process and control improvements.

Genuine interest in financial markets, currencies and institutional portfolio management.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.

CFA designation or progress toward the CFA is preferred.

Relevant experience within institutional asset management, currency management, investment operations or global markets.

Experience with FX trading and portfolio-management platforms is beneficial.

Knowledge of transaction-cost analysis and execution-quality monitoring is advantageous.

title: Head of Cybersecurity
description:
About Us

KIDAN is a fast-growing, family-owned IT consulting company headquartered in Switzerland, serving nearly 1'000 enterprise clients. Since 2020, we’ve been helping businesses turn IT into a strategic advantage through smart, secure, and scalable solutions.

We specialize in IT management and security, and we are the exclusive Swiss distributor of ManageEngine, with strong partnerships including Cloudflare, Colortokens, SentinelOne, Zoho, Horizon3, Quest, and others. Our team of international experts is driven by excellence, integrity, and a people-first mindset.

At KIDAN, we don’t just solve IT problems—we enable long-term business success.

Be part of a mission where technology drives progress and people lead the way.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Own KIDAN's Cybersecurity Posture

  • Own KIDAN's overall cybersecurity posture, strategy, policies, standards and roadmap.

  • Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across KIDAN's technology, operations and internal environment.

  • Identify and challenge cyber risks, gaps and priorities, and drive corrective actions.

  • Own cybersecurity compliance and support certifications and frameworks such as ISO 27001.

  • Work closely with Technology, Operations and leadership to ensure cybersecurity is built into how KIDAN operates.

  • Be technically involved in assessing KIDAN's cybersecurity architecture, technologies, configurations, controls and implementations.

  • Regularly go beyond governance and documentation to validate that cyber controls are actually implemented and working effectively in practice.

2. Provide Hands-On Technical Cybersecurity Leadership

  • Act as a technical cybersecurity leader who can get into the field and work directly with technical teams.

  • Review and challenge cybersecurity architectures, technical designs, configurations, implementations and controls.

  • Participate directly in complex cyber investigations, incident response, escalations and technical problem-solving when required.

  • Work alongside engineers, cybersecurity specialists and SOC analysts to solve complex cyber challenges and improve technical capabilities.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the technologies, tools and platforms used across KIDAN's cybersecurity environment.

  • Be able to independently understand and assess technical cyber issues rather than relying exclusively on the team for technical interpretation.

  • Set the technical standard for the cybersecurity organization and continuously raise the team's technical maturity.

  • Remain sufficiently hands-on to maintain technical credibility with both internal teams and enterprise customers.

3. Own & Develop the Cybersecurity Offering

  • Own the strategy, quality and relevance of KIDAN's cybersecurity offering.

  • Continuously challenge and improve our cybersecurity services, capabilities and value proposition.

  • Ensure our SOC and cybersecurity services (e.g. detection and response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, cyber resilience) are technically strong, operationally mature and aligned with enterprise customer needs.

  • Stay close to the actual delivery of our cybersecurity services and understand how our offerings are implemented in real customer environments.

  • Work with the commercial and technology teams to identify opportunities to grow KIDAN's cybersecurity business and revenue.

  • Ensure what we sell is what we can genuinely deliver at a high standard.

  • Participate in the design and evolution of cybersecurity solutions, architectures and service models.

  • Support the team in complex technical customer opportunities where senior cybersecurity expertise is required.

4. Challenge Cybersecurity Delivery

  • Ensure cybersecurity services and projects are delivered to a consistently high standard.

  • Stay close to delivery and regularly engage with the teams doing the technical work.

  • Challenge processes, technical decisions, architecture and delivery quality where cybersecurity standards are not met.

  • Review technical deliverables and cybersecurity implementations where appropriate.

  • Oversee the SOC team and ensure strong operational performance, processes, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Establish clear cybersecurity KPIs, controls and quality standards.

  • Step into critical delivery, technical escalations or cyber incidents when the situation requires senior technical expertise.

  • Ensure lessons from cyber incidents, projects and customer engagements are translated into improvements across the cybersecurity function.

5. Enterprise Customer & Cybersecurity Escalation Point

  • Act as a senior cybersecurity point of contact for key enterprise customers.

  • Be comfortable going into customer environments and engaging directly with technical teams, cybersecurity teams, IT leaders and executives.

  • Lead or support customer discussions around cybersecurity strategy, architecture, compliance, cyber risk and major requirements.

  • Participate in technical workshops, cyber risk assessments, architecture discussions and complex customer engagements.

  • Act as the escalation point for critical cybersecurity topics, incidents and customer concerns.

  • Be able to discuss technical cybersecurity topics at depth with experienced customer cyber and IT professionals.

  • Build trust with customers by bringing strong technical expertise, credibility and business understanding.

6. Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Establish clear cybersecurity governance, ownership and decision-making across KIDAN.

  • Ensure cyber risks are visible and appropriately escalated to leadership.

  • Partner with Technology, Compliance, Operations and other functions on cybersecurity priorities and risk management.

  • Lead, coach and develop the cybersecurity team, creating a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement.

  • Lead by technical credibility and expertise, not only through management and delegation.

description:
Gasfin is where engineering meets impact. Since 2009, we’ve been building and managing world-class LNG infrastructure projects across the globe—from the drawing board to real-world delivery. Our clients include governments, energy companies, and infrastructure operators, all working toward the same goal: secure, stable, and sustainable energy.

In 2023, we became the lead consultant and in 2025 also the On-Site Operations Manager for Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH (DET)—Germany’s state-owned terminal operator, created to respond to the national energy supply challenges triggered by the Ukraine crisis.
We believe energy should be reliable, affordable, and future-ready. That’s why we view LNG as a powerful transition fuel on the path to greener energy systems.

Tasks

The Head of Operations will be responsible for providing senior-level technical and operational leadership and ensuring the safe, reliable and efficient operation of the LNG FSRU terminals. This is a senior leadership role requiring extensive LNG or natural gas expertise, sound technical judgement and the ability to manage complex operational, regulatory and commercial interfaces. The position acts as the company’s primary technical and operational authority and assumes decision-making responsibility in the absence of the Managing Director.

  • Provide strategic oversight of the day-to-day technical operation of LNG FSRU terminals, including regasification systems, cryogenic storage, boil-off gas management and gas grid feed-in.
  • Act as the primary technical authority for operational teams and engineering functions, providing expert guidance and escalation support on complex technical matters.
  • Ensure consistent, high-quality performance across terminal operations, maintenance, asset integrity and engineering activities.
  • Lead complex troubleshooting and root-cause analyses for critical equipment and process issues requiring senior engineering judgement.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable European and national regulations, technical codes, classification requirements, safety standards and company policies.
  • Review and approve CAPEX and OPEX proposals, engineering modifications and technical upgrades, with accountability for technical scope, operational impact and budget.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance asset reliability, technical performance, energy efficiency and safety culture.
  • Coordinate closely with Commercial, Terminal Management and HSE functions, ensuring effective alignment across operational and strategic priorities.
  • Represent the company at a senior technical level in dealings with authorities, engineering contractors, suppliers, classification societies and other external stakeholders.
  • Interface with gas grid operators and regulatory stakeholders regarding the technical requirements for gas network integration.
  • Provide senior technical leadership during emergency response, incident management and contingency planning.
  • Monitor technical and operational performance indicators and provide regular reports and recommendations to senior management.
  • Contribute to regular reporting, both to internal and external stakeholders.
  • The role will have at least 4 direct reports and multiple indirects.

Requirements

A successful Head of Operations should have:

  • A minimum of ten years of professional experience within the LNG, natural gas or gas processing industry, gained in senior technical operations, engineering or project management roles.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the entire LNG value chain, including liquefaction, shipping logistics, cryogenic storage, regasification and gas grid feed-in.
  • A proven track record in senior technical leadership positions such as Lead Engineer, Engineering Manager, Chief Engineer or Technical Superintendent.
  • Expert knowledge of LNG regasification systems, cryogenic processes, boil-off gas management and associated marine and terminal systems.
  • Extensive experience in asset integrity management, reliability engineering, maintenance strategies and HSE management frameworks.
  • Strong knowledge of relevant European and German regulatory frameworks, technical and safety codes, classification requirements and permitting processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to make autonomous, high-impact (technical) decisions under time pressure in safety-critical and mission-critical environments.
  • Experience working with regulatory authorities, classification societies, engineering contractors, suppliers and gas grid operators.
  • Strong commercial awareness and experience assessing investments, CAPEX and OPEX proposals and engineering/design modifications.
  • Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence both senior management and operational teams.
  • Fluent written and spoken English; German language skills would be a significant advantage.

Benefits

  • The opportunity to play an active role in shaping the future of pioneering LNG terminals
  • Responsible tasks in a technically demanding environment
  • A dedicated team with open communication and flat hierarchies
  • Competitive compensation and long-term development opportunities

Become part of Gasfin and help shape the future of LNG infrastructure.

Are you an experienced Statistical Programming professional with deep knowledge of clinical drug development? Would you like to use your technical expertise to provide strategic programming leadership and help shape the delivery of clinical development programmes? Join us at AstraZeneca CVRM (Cardiovascular Renal Metabolism) Biometrics to impact a wide range of engaging projects striving to make a difference for millions of patients. Our Biometrics team consists of Statisticians, Programmers, Information and Data Scientists. We drive and contribute to optimized clinical drug development programs and access to information and scientific knowledge management.

We are now offering an exciting opportunity for a dedicated and highly motivated individual to join us as Statistical Programming, Associate Director, providing strategic programming leadership within CVRM Biometrics and collaborating with global product development teams.

This role is primarily focused on strategic and technical leadership, planning and project management rather than hands-on statistical programming. You will draw on your technical programming expertise to provide direction, oversee delivery and support high-quality decision-making.

This role will be placed at AstraZeneca’s dynamic R&D strategic site in Gothenburg (Sweden), where you will work in an international environment at the forefront of clinical development.

Accountabilities:

As a Statistical Programming, Associate Director, you are accountable for quality, timely and efficient delivery of project programming work and information management. This position requires profound programming experience and excellent industry knowledge to provide strategic and technical leadership across programming activities, including planning and project management. This is a strategic leadership role with project and technical focus where you will provide subject matter expertise within the statistical programming discipline. You will oversee the delivery of data according to industry standards, and high-quality statistical analyses and reporting deliverables, as well as planning and execution of submission strategies. You will act as a specialist within cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, innovation, and automation solutions.

Essential Skills/Experience:

Degree in Mathematics (e.g., Applied Math, Engineering, etc.), Statistics, Computer Science, Life Science, or equivalent experience

Advanced knowledge of the clinical development process and industry standards

Demonstrated programming leadership capability, with the ability to provide strategic and technical direction, develop teams and individuals, and lead them towards a common goal without formal line management responsibility

Demonstrated influencing, planning and organizational skills

Ability to provide input to functional strategies

Expertise in risk management in complex or novel situations

Strong technical experience in SAS and CDISC standards, together with current knowledge and awareness of regulatory requirements relevant to Statistical Programming

 

Desirable Skills/Experience:

Broad experience, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas and/or beyond Statistical Programming

Experience in regulatory submissions and regulatory interactions

Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing business processes

Willingness and ability to travel

At AstraZeneca, we believe in the potential of our people, and you’ll develop beyond what you thought possible. We make the most of your skills and passion by actively supporting you to see what you can achieve no matter where you start with us. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal role in channeling our scientific capabilities to make a positive impact on changing patients’ lives and join us on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.

This role is an office-based role with some degree of flexibility. Our vibrant office sites provide a diverse and collaborative work environment, where interactions lead to ideas and innovations, giving you and others the perfect opportunity to learn, grow and develop careers.

Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have a seat available, and we hope it’s yours. Apply today!

title: Director EUIT, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio
description:
The Director, Finance Product Impact, Value and Portfolio is accountable for proving and growing the value delivered by all 17 Finance IT products across Core Finance and Finance Planning and Analytics. This role owns product health and maturity measurement, value-realisation and benefits tracking against the run-cost bridge, the product portfolio and demand pipeline, product craft standards, and the single in-house performance scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods. Reporting to the Executive Director, Finance IT, and leading a team of four, the Director gives the leadership team the evidence needed to decide where to invest, sustain, consolidate or retire, and to confirm that the product-and-platform operating model is delivering outcomes, not just activity. Central to the role is making the true value of IT visible and credible to the business; recognising IT not merely as a cost to be contained but as a driver of capacity, speed, quality, control and competitive advantage for the Core Functions and translating that value into hard outcomes, including a measurable productivity saving of at least 10% for each function served. The Director partners closely with the two Product Line Leads, the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions, the Director Transformation and Product Experience, senior Finance business leaders, strategic partners, Procurement, and Central Technology Risk and Data Governance to maximise value and innovation in a product-centric organisation. 

  

Key Responsibilities  

Value Realisation and Benefits Tracking: Define and run the value-measurement discipline across all 17 products, tracking benefits against the run-cost bridge ($20.0M today to the $15.0M plan of record and the $13.5M stretch aim). Report the value of agents that run IT itself and of agents that serve the business separately, never netted. Own the target of delivering a 10% productivity saving for each Core Function releasing time, effort and spend to be reinvested in higher-value work and evidence it product by product alongside the run-cost bridge, so the function sees a clear, auditable return on its IT investment.  

• Product Health and Maturity: Maintain one consistent health and maturity view of every product, covering adoption, quality, user experience, run cost and control health. Trigger intervention with the Product Line Leads where a product falls below threshold, and keep the evidence base current for leadership and gate reviews.  

• Portfolio and Demand Management: Own the portfolio and demand pipeline and keep prioritisation honest. Recommend which products to invest in, sustain, consolidate or retire, and support the phased launch of the 17 products.  

• Agent and Pod Performance Scorecard: Own the single scorecard for AI agents and partner delivery pods, covering accuracy, deflection, Service-Level Agreement and Experience-Level Agreement performance, and cost. Provide the evidence for the agent governance plane and for the two-of-four pause criterion at each phase gate.  

• Product Craft and Standards: Raise product-management craft across Product Owners and Product Analysts through standards, playbooks, coaching and a graduate pipeline, so that every product team operates to a consistent, defensible bar.  

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team of four, comprising two Value Measurement Leads and two Product Craft and Agent Scorecard specialists. Foster a culture of evidence, accountability and continuous improvement, and own talent development and succession planning for key roles.  

• Stakeholder and Partner Management: Manage and influence the Executive Director, Product Line Leads and senior Finance business leaders on value and portfolio decisions. Hold the embedded Outsourcing partner to account on outcome measures, working with EUIT Operational Excellence on supplier governance and with Procurement on commercial terms such as gain-share and service credits.  

• Governance, Risk and Compliance: Ensure value, benefits and scorecard reporting is auditable and evidence-based. Work with Central Technology Risk and Data Governance on AI guardrails, and ensure no agent is treated as a control until the first clean financial year-end and per-agent auditor sign-off are in place. 

• AI Adoption and Change Management: Be the thought leader for measuring the impact of AI digital workers. Feed adoption and performance evidence to the Director Transformation and Product Experience and the Senior Director Product Design and Solutions so that digital-worker leverage is directed where it creates most value. 

• Budget Management: Develop, deliver and monitor the budget, including capital, for the Product Impact, Value and Portfolio area, and track the savings run-rate against plan, flagging early where it falls below 85% of plan.  

Key Qualifications, Skills and Experience  

Key Qualifications:  

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of study – Finance, Business, Engineering, Computer Science or Information Technology. Masters degree desirable.  

• Significant experience in a client-facing IT or product role, including strategic planning, business plan and case development, and client management.  

• Significant experience in value realisation and benefits tracking, including business models, operating models, financial models, cost-benefit analysis, budgeting and risk management.  

• Significant experience in product-centric operating models, including product portfolio and demand management, product health and maturity measurement, and product-management craft.  

• Significant experience working with diverse business ecosystems, Cloud and software-as-a-service models, and business applications. More specifically: SAP S/4HANA, BlackLine, Anaplan, Snowflake, Coupa, Concur and AWS Bedrock plus AI foundation models, large language models and measuring the performance of AI agents.  

• Significant experience in one or more Finance areas with a comprehensive understanding of business processes and drivers for success, such as record to report, purchase to pay, order to cash, and planning and forecasting.  

• Experience working with regulatory and control aspects of IT solutions in Finance, including Sarbanes-Oxley attestation and audit-ready evidence.  

• Experience having led large-scale change initiatives from planning to implementation.  

• Experience managing teams with direct and indirect reports, including work delivered through outsourced managed-service partners.  

• Experience managing outcome-based managed-service contracts, including Service-Level Agreements, Experience-Level Agreements, service credits and gain-share mechanisms.  

• Experience in co-working with cross-functional global leadership and other senior stakeholders preferred.  

• Substantial experience managing in a global matrix organisation with geographically dispersed teams.  

• Substantial experience communicating with and influencing diverse internal and external stakeholders, including supplier and vendor networks, across areas and geographies to drive value and portfolio outcomes.  

• Substantial experience anticipating, assessing and managing programme and portfolio risks.  

• Certification in product management, portfolio management or business analysis preferred.  

  

Skills & Technical Proficiency:  

• Critical/ Strategic Thinking: Influences the broader business strategy with data and insights and anticipates futuristic changes.  

• Results & Execution Focus: Sets ambitious yet realistic value targets, measures them rigorously and holds product teams and partners to outcomes.  

• Business & Sustainability: Leverages a strong understanding of the organisational structure and business financials to make strategic recommendations and advocate for sustainable business strategies.  

• Adaptability & Change Orientation: Champions bold moves and systemic changes and models resilience when faced with unexpected changes.  

• Communication, Collaboration & Influence: Is an inspiring communicator, builds strong partnerships, and bridges silos to achieve broader organisational goals.  

• Talent Development: Champions a culture based on feedforward, coaching, and stretch development and ensures a level playing field for diverse talent.  

• Business & Customer Centricity: Leverages a strong understanding of Finance functional domains, customer processes and the related IT landscape to judge where product investment creates most value.  

• Value & Insight Storytelling: Turns product, cost and performance data into clear, decision-ready evidence for the Executive Director and senior Finance leaders, and is candid when the evidence is unwelcome.  

• Product Craft & Portfolio Judgement: Applies product-management standards and portfolio thinking to prioritise, sequence and retire products, balancing value, risk and capacity.  

• AI Performance Measurement: Designs and runs measures for AI agents and partner delivery pods, and drives a culture of proactive change, skill building and application around emerging technologies and ways of working.

Your next mission

Scale our operations for global impact. Build the systems and teams – so our radar tech delivers everywhere it counts.

You also build and lead the Operational Excellence department, ensuring our daily operations stay sharp while we grow.

What you'll do

  • End-to-end process and quality improvement: Drive continuous process improvement and alignment across the entire value chain, from sales quote to field deployment, without disrupting daily operations. Maintain and improve our operational quality management system to meet industry standards.

  • Data governance and planning systems: Lead operational data governance and planning system improvements. Provide real-time visibility into lead times, yield, capacity and Sales and Operations Planning inputs.

  • Product Lifecycle Management (PLM): Oversee PLM governance to connect Innovation and Development with Operations. Ensure full product traceability across the complete product delivery and maintenance lifecycle.

  • Global expansion and outsourcing: Lead strategic outsourcing projects with external project leads to scale manufacturing capacity. Prepare manufacturing processes for global expansion, including meeting local US manufacturing regulations and establishing regional assembly centres.

  • Team leadership and strategic advice: Build, lead and develop the Operational Excellence department by setting clear goals and supporting team growth. Act as an internal consultant on cross-functional projects, and advise the Management Team with transparent reporting, risk assessments and budget management.

What you bring

  • MSc degree preferred in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or a related technical field.

  • 12+ years of leadership experience in operational excellence, factory scaling, or manufacturing transformation within high-tech, defense, electronics, or aerospace industries.

  • Proven track record of transitioning a company from low-volume internal assembly to large-scale external contract manufacturing.

  • Deep understanding of how to connect product design (I&D), enterprise planning software (ERP), and factory production execution.

  • Strong business acumen with the ability to model multi-year capacity plans, CAPEX investments, ROI for automation/outsourcing, and unit-cost reduction curves.

  • Experience training organizations in lean methodologies, project management, process standardization, and quality management systems.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

  • Ability to lead cross-departmental change management effectively without disrupting ongoing business operations.

  • HQ-based role in Delft, Netherlands, following a hybrid work policy, with approximately 10% travel to strategic manufacturing partners, supply chain hubs, and international expansion sites.

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by allowing them to build better software, together. We're looking for an experienced Senior Solutions Engineer in the United States to provide technical presales support for our enterprise customer base — in regulated industries, particularly financial services and healthcare.   

 

Our Senior Solutions Engineers are responsible for the technical relationships with customers and prospects, working as a trusted advisor to remove technical objections and creatively address pain points in a customer's SDLC. They will work internally with sales and product development teams to identify solutions that meet customers' business needs and document requests to expand the capabilities of GitHub's platform.  

 

We're extremely passionate about the quality of our work. If you are technically sharp, business minded, and people oriented, you might be a fit for this role! 


Responsibilities

  • Identifying customer business & technical requirements and matching them to product solutions. 

  • Building joint customer strategies with enterprise sales, support, and customer success to encourage product adoption. 

  • Delivering live demonstrations of GitHub’s products and platform to prospective customers.  

  • Navigating complex technical scenarios to help customers migrate to GitHub from their existing development tools and workflows.  

  • Building relationships with key decision makers and serving as a customer's technical point of contact and advocate.  

  • Learning about customers' successes and challenges, sharing customer feedback within GitHub, and advocating for customer interests.  

  • Applying understanding of customer environment and goals to provide oversight and guide post-sales teams to successful outcomes. 


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

    • OR equivalent experience.

    • DevSecOps, including software composition and security analysis, SAST/DAST tooling, and common patterns & industry trends 

    • Agentic software development practices and tools.

Can translate complex technology into clear positioning, audience narratives, and thought leadership that resonate across SMB segments.

In this high-impact leadership role, you will strategically own the implementation and evolution of our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Manufacturing Execution (MES) systems and processes to scale with a rapidly growing product and manufacturing organization ("Digital Thread").
You will govern the product architecture for our complex mechatronic systems, ensuring that our Engineering BOM (EBOM), Manufacturing BOM (MBOM), and Service BOM (SBOM) are perfectly synchronized. 
This is not just a systems role — it’s a business transformation mandate. You will define and execute the PLM and MES roadmap in collaboration with executive stakeholders, ensuring alignment between engineering, operations, product, and after-sales service functions. You’ll help us build an integrated, enterprise-grade ecosystem that accelerates product development, enables traceability, and scales product data excellence.

 
 

The Market & Our Technology

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customized hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics mechanical hardware.


Your Impact
  • Product Structure & Configuration Governance
  • BOM Mastery: Define and govern multi-level BOM structures for complex robotic systems, ensuring alignment across Engineering, Manufacturing, and Service.
  • Modular Architecture: Support platform-based development by managing product configurations, variants, and component reuse strategies.
  • Data Standards: Enforce rigorous part-numbering schemes, revision control, and BOM rules to maintain 100% data integrity.
  • PLM System Ownership & Digital Thread
  • Platform Management: Own the strategic roadmap, implementation and functional administration of the PLM environment (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, CIM Database).
  • System Integration: Manage the technical "Digital Thread" between CAD → PLM → ERP → MES, ensuring real-time synchronization of product and manufacturing data.
  • Release Management: Oversee the lifecycle states, access controls, and workflows for all product releases and configuration baselines.
  • MES & Manufacturing Data Integration
  • Production Execution: Ensure the flawless transfer of product structures from PLM to the MES for production execution.
  • Process Definition: Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering to define production routings, assembly sequences, and digital work instructions in the MES.
  • Traceability: Maintain "As-Built" traceability, ensuring consistency between MES production data and ERP production orders.
  • Engineering Change (ECM) & Continuous Improvement
  • Change Governance: Lead the Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Order (ECO) processes, ensuring controlled propagation of changes across all systems.
  • Optimization: Drive continuous improvement in workflows to reduce NPI (New Product Introduction) cycle times and improve manufacturing scalability.
  • Audit & Compliance: Conduct regular product data audits and implement corrective actions to ensure "Single Source of Truth" reliability.

    • Your Profile
  • Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering

  • 7+ years of experience in Configuration, PLM and MES system management, administration and implementation, ideally in hardware or complex mechatronic product environments

  • Proven track record leading cross-functional PLM projects with enterprise impact — from roadmap design to hands-on delivery

  • Strong technical knowledge of PLM architectures (e.g., Teamcenter, Windchill, Arena, CIM Database), MES systems (e.g. Tulip, Opcenter) and their integration with ERP, CAD, and quality systems

  • Deep understanding of business processes spanning engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and service

  • Highly effective communicator with the ability to engage and influence at all levels, including senior leadership and management

  • Demonstrated mentoring, training, or enablement of teams in system adoption and process maturity Fluency in English required; German is a strong plus


    • Bonus Points
  • Prior experience in scaling PLM environments in a high-growth startup or SME

  • Familiarity with quality management systems and industry regulations, e.g. ATEX directives

  • Experience in AI-enabled or robotics-based product companies

    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
     
     
    Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

description:
About this role

We are looking for a Staff Cyber Security Specialist (f/m/x) to strengthen our Incident Response and Security Operations capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced incident responder who enjoys solving complex security challenges and helping organizations navigate critical cyber incidents.

In this role, you will lead incident response engagements from investigation through recovery, working directly with customers during some of their most challenging moments. You will act as a trusted technical authority within the team, mentor less experienced responders, and help drive improvements across our security operations.


Unlike traditional consultancy environments, you will operate within a product-driven MDR organization serving more than 1,000 customers across Europe. This gives you the opportunity to work at scale, leverage large security datasets, and contribute improvements that strengthen protections across our entire customer base.


You will work with state-of-the-art security tooling while collaborating with security professionals from intelligence, military, consulting, national CERT, and technology backgrounds.

Alongside operational response work, you'll have opportunities to contribute to internal research initiatives, Bug Bounty Fridays, Capture The Flag events, and other technical projects that help push our capabilities forward.

This position reports directly to the Director of Security Operations.

What you will do

  • Act as a leading technical authority within Security Operations, taking ownership of strategic improvement initiatives and helping shape the future direction of our incident response and security operations capabilities.

  • Lead cyber incident response engagements from intake through recovery.

  • Act as the technical lead during investigations, coordinating response activities and driving outcomes.

  • Conduct forensic investigations to determine attack scope, root cause, and impact.

  • Support customers during active cybersecurity incidents and provide clear technical guidance.

  • Support MDR and Security Operations activities when not engaged in active incident response cases.

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders, including management, legal counsel, law enforcement, and regulators when required.

  • Mentor junior and medior responders and help raise the technical maturity of the team.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of incident response methodologies, playbooks, and operational processes.

What you will need

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, Digital Forensics, Security Operations, or related disciplines.

  • Proven ability to independently lead and manage cybersecurity incidents end-to-end.

  • In-depth knowledge of Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems, file systems, security architecture, and attack surfaces.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, networking, and network security principles.

  • Experience with EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or similar technologies.

  • Knowledge of cloud environments and cloud security concepts across Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills with experience collecting and analysing evidence during security incidents.

  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other security professionals.

  • Strong ownership, collaboration, and communication skills.

  • Fluency in English (internal working language)

  • C2 Fluency in German (required for client communication)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience developing scripts, tools, or automations to support investigations and response activities.

  • Experience conducting technical security research.

  • Knowledge of threat actors and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

  • Experience working in a CERT, CSIRT, MDR, or DFIR environment.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds

  • A remote-friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats (in Spain, Portugal, Italy…)

  • Thursday socials to stay connected

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days

About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 170 FTEs and continue to grow internationally.

 

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

 

At Eye, you’ll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

title: Chief of Staff Tech - Engineering
description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 
 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.

You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.

 

Team and Context

Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter.

You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.

Key missions

Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives

  • Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown

  • Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution

  • Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership

Planning & Performance tracking

  • Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership

  • Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable

  • Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction)

Decision-making and leadership cadence

  • Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land

  • Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next

  • Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team

Communication

  • Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates

Who you’ll work with?

  • CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers)

  • Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives)

  • Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People)

Who we’re looking for

Must-have

  • An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum)

  • Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers

  • 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering

  • A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders

  • Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on

  • Fluency in English

Nice-to-have

  • A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent

  • Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company

What you can expect?

Within one month

  • You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices

  • You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment

  • You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone

Within 3-6 months

  • You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target

  • The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions

  • You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them

  • You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

- An interview with Quentin - CTO (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Nathan - Head of Product Strat&Ops (45 mins)

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

Job ID: 10587152 | Amazon Data Services, Inc.

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. 

You’ll join a diverse team of technical program managers, design engineers, construction managers, network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to oversee data center build projects. Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through scope and schedule creation, budget management, completed design, implementation, commissioning, and data center deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, critical thinking skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders, eliminate non-value-add activities, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

The successful candidate will be a strong communicator (both written and verbal), not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities, and be capable of understanding mechanical/electrical engineering concepts. They will be able to apply a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include experience with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, KanBan, Playbook, SQL and systems integration a plus.

Key job responsibilities

We are seeking a Sr. Technical Infrastructure Program Manager who to own and deliver on end-to-end builds. Working with stakeholder teams to map dependencies, create and drive schedules, as well as think big to solve some of our biggest challenges! We're looking for a highly organized, attention to detail, problem solver with the ability to dive deep into critical path items. This is a high judgement role to deliver capacity to our end customers.

About the team

*Why AWS*

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
