title: Senior Service Delivery Engineer
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, Germany

Overview

GitHub helps companies and organizations succeed by enabling them to build better software, together. We're looking for a Senior Service Delivery Engineer to support our Expert Services team in solving our customers' needs. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion to become a master of GitHub's product capabilities and underlying technologies. We need a high performing engineering consultant to help our customers improve their software delivery. This person will solve challenges with many different technologies and work closely with our customers, as well as GitHub's internal departments


Responsibilities

Delivery Readiness

  • Monitor and evaluate performance and support readiness in delivery quality for customers and specific internal teams

  • Share technical expertise and contribute to the success of the team by providing coaching and role readiness training

  • Continue to evolve product knowledge to prepare for new product releases

 

Customer Delivery

  • Drive services pre-sales and scoping exercises to position GitHub value drivers to customers by focusing on customer outcomes

  • Enhance customer adoption of the GitHub platform while achieving targeted average billable utilization and Customer Satisfaction goals

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping solve increasingly complex technical issues

  • Provide advice to customers and partners during engagements

  • Manage client expectations, scope of work, and draft change orders as needed

  • Complete service delivery engagements within time and budget, while meeting customer expectations

  • Develop repeat business by positioning the value of future services delivery phases

 

Collaboration

  • Collaborate on cross-team and cross-product technical issues by working with resources from other groups

  • Help drive top organizational priorities by working with managers, engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders

  • Engage and collaborate with other GitHub groups to gain resolution for critical, complex issues

  • Advocate for product improvements based on customer feedback

  • Build communities to resolve customer and partner issues

 

Solutions Development

  • Understand customer goals and help create tailored solutions

  • Provide technical clarity regarding an array of technologies

  • Help customers make informed decisions by weighing critical technical solutions

  • Create high-quality, reusable solutions for customers

  • Build solutions such as migrating source code from legacy systems, creating CI/CD pipelines, or automating infrastructure provisioning


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR equivalent experience

  • 1+ year(s) experience leading customer projects

  • Experience in Software Development or DevOps

  • In-depth knowledge of the Git version control system

Preferred Qualifications

  • 9+ years experience in technical consulting, software development, application security, or related field

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 7+ years experience

    • OR Master's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years experience

  • 3+ years experience leading customer projects

  • 3+ years experience in technical consulting

  • Familiarity with the GitHub platform and associated workflows or familiarity with legacy version control systems (SVN, CVS, ClearCase, AccuRev, etc.)

  • Strong experience with AI-assisted coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate and improve software development workflows

  • Business level proficiency in German, Dutch, French or Spanish 

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

Equal Employment Opportunity

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

title: Team Lead - Internal Solution Consulting
description:
Contexte du rôle

Le ou la Team Lead Solution Consulting est responsable de l’organisation, de la performance et du développement de l’équipe de Solution Consultants.

L’équipe intervient auprès des clients Pennylane sur la dimension fonctionnelle de projets en cours : analyse des besoins, cadrage, mise en œuvre, formation et adoption du produit.

Par son management, sa coordination et son pilotage de la capacité, le ou la Team Lead veille à ce que les clients bénéficient d’un accompagnement de qualité, au bon moment et avec le niveau d’expertise attendu.

Missions principales

  • Manager et développer l’équipe Solution Consulting : définir les objectifs individuels et collectifs, organiser les rituels de management, accompagner la montée en compétences, donner du feedback et suivre la performance. Veiller à l’engagement, à la motivation et à la dynamique collective.

  • Organiser et optimiser le staffing de l’équipe : consolider les besoins liés aux projets en cours, anticiper la charge, répartir les missions en fonction des compétences et des disponibilités, et s’assurer que les ressources sont mobilisées au bon moment et sur les bons sujets.

  • Définir les règles de priorisation et anticiper les tensions de capacité : construire des principes de priorisation et de staffing partagés avec les équipes Sales et les autres parties prenantes, arbitrer les demandes concurrentes, identifier les risques de surcharge ou de sous-capacité et alerter en cas de risque sur les délais ou la qualité.

  • Superviser l’efficacité opérationnelle et la performance de l’équipe : définir et suivre les indicateurs clés de l’activité, notamment la couverture des besoins, les délais de staffing, la charge de l’équipe, le respect des engagements, la qualité des accompagnements et les difficultés liées à la coordination ou à la capacité.

  • Garantir les standards de qualité et les méthodes de travail : définir et faire évoluer les bonnes pratiques applicables à l’analyse fonctionnelle, au cadrage, aux ateliers, aux formations, à la documentation et aux livrables produits par l’équipe.

  • Coordonner les parties prenantes internes : faciliter la collaboration entre les Solution Consultants, les équipes Sales et Account Management, les PrM ou équipes Delivery, les CSM, Solution Engineering, Produit, Support, Operations et People.

  • Développer l’amélioration continue de la fonction : analyser les retours terrain, identifier les irritants, faire évoluer les outils, les processus et les modes de fonctionnement, et faciliter la contribution de l’équipe aux demandes prioritaires, notamment aux réponses à des appels d’offres lorsque l’expertise fonctionnelle est requise et que la demande est priorisée selon les enjeux business.

Profil recherché

  • Vous justifiez d’au moins 2 ans d’expérience en management de proximité et dans l’accompagnement d’une équipe.

  • Vous avez une expérience dans le pilotage d’une activité impliquant plusieurs projets, ressources, niveaux d’expertise et parties prenantes.

  • Vous disposez d’une bonne compréhension des environnements de conseil fonctionnel, de déploiement logiciel, de formation, de Customer Success ou de Professional Services.

  • Vous maîtrisez les enjeux de capacity planning, de staffing, d’allocation des ressources et de gestion de la charge.

  • Vous savez définir des objectifs, suivre la performance, donner du feedback et accompagner les évolutions professionnelles.

  • Vous êtes capable de structurer des processus, des standards et des méthodes de travail dans un environnement en évolution.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec le pilotage par les données et la construction d’indicateurs opérationnels pertinents.

  • Vous savez prioriser, arbitrer et prendre des décisions dans un contexte de demandes concurrentes.

  • Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités de communication, de coordination et d’influence auprès d’équipes aux responsabilités différentes.

  • Vous êtes orienté vers la qualité de l’expérience client, pragmatique, attentif au collectif et engagé dans l’amélioration continue.

description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:
$68,000.00 - $93,500.00

Location:
Kalispell,MT

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Key Responsibilities

Support specific project and program objectives as  defined in the areas of responsibility, and that necessary preliminary activities (e.g., determination of outcomes, milestones, viability studies, and resource planning, among others) are completed.

Support projects and programs assigned are completed in accordance with predetermined requirements, with specific attention to product/process specifications, project/program costs, resource utilization, and timeliness for completion.

Ensures that all phases of project, program and/or process development are documented and that information required in other functional areas is reported, disseminated, or transferred, as appropriate. Ensures compliance with Company policies regarding Engineering/Lab notebooks, patents, confidentiality and safety.

Undertake study of new technologies, as appropriate. 

Support data collection for materials & financial resources.

Other Requirements: This position may require standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools.

Additionally, because this position also may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required.

Functional Knowledge

Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities

Business Expertise

Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work

Leadership

No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members

Problem Solving

Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents 

Impact

Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies

Interpersonal Skills

Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations

The NSO Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of assigned Non-System Orders (NSOs) from project release through shipment. This individual contributor role serves as the primary coordinator for complex, customer-specific system configurations, ensuring all project milestones, deliverables, manufacturing requirements, and shipment commitments are achieved.

The NSO Project Manager partners closely with the Business Management Operations (BMO) team, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Quality, and Configuration Management organizations to manage project execution, mitigate risk, resolve issues, and ensure alignment between customer requirements and factory readiness. The role requires strong project management skills, exceptional organizational abilities, and the capacity to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of assigned NSO projects from order release through shipment.

Translate customer-specific requirements received through the BMO organization into executable manufacturing and project plans.

Develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules, key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and execution risks.

Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure engineering, manufacturing, material, quality, and configuration requirements are completed on schedule.

Serve as the central point of coordination for project scope, schedule, configuration, and readiness activities.

Drive execution of customer-specific configurations, engineering changes, BOM modifications, NSRs, CES requests, and other non-standard requirements.

Assess and communicate the impact of project changes on delivery schedules, manufacturing readiness, and shipment commitments.

Facilitate project reviews, readiness reviews, production status meetings, and issue resolution activities.

Monitor project health and performance, identifying constraints and initiating recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

Partner with Master Scheduling, Operations Management, and BMO teams to prioritize deliverables and maintain execution alignment.

Lead risk identification and mitigation activities, ensuring project risks are proactively managed and escalated when necessary.

Coordinate resolution of manufacturing, quality, material, and engineering issues affecting project execution.

Support shipment readiness activities, including final test coordination, documentation reviews, and production release requirements.

Maintain accurate project documentation, action-item tracking, schedule status, and project metrics.

Provide timely status updates, risk assessments, and recovery plans to stakeholders and leadership.

Identify and implement process improvements that enhance NSO execution efficiency, predictability, and customer delivery performance.

Success in This Role Requires

Strong project management, organizational, and prioritization skills.

Ability to manage multiple highly customized projects simultaneously in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of manufacturing operations, change management, configuration management, and production planning processes.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across multiple functional organizations.

Proven ability to manage risk, resolve conflicts, and maintain commitments in highly dynamic project environments.

Additional Information

Time Type:
Full time

Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular

Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:
No

In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable.

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

description:
We're looking for a Technical Program Manager with strong Product thinking to drive inline's Table Management System (TMS) and Food Ordering (FO) products, together with our global partner integrations.
The right person in this role will play a pivotal role in planning, building, and scaling the products that power restaurants' front-of-house operations — reservations, table management, queuing, deposits & payments, and food ordering — while connecting inline to a growing ecosystem of global partners such as booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls, and regional restaurant groups. The key to this role is orchestrating complex, multi-stakeholder programs that serve merchants, patrons, and partners at once, and turning deep F&B domain knowledge into product decisions that improve merchant operations and patron experiences across markets.
Responsibilities

Strategy & Prioritization

Partner closely with the stakeholders and UX design team to shape and translate product vision into executable roadmaps for the TMS and FO product lines.

Conduct market research and competitive analysis across the F&B tech landscape (reservation platforms, POS ecosystems, food ordering, channel managers) to provide product recommendations.

Evaluate product and integration opportunities by balancing merchant value, patron experience, partner impact, engineering effort, and operational complexity.

Continuously monitor product and partner metrics (e.g. partner-driven bookings, seated conversion, no-show rate) and provide insights to refine priorities and roadmap execution.

Program Management

Lead cross-functional programs from planning through execution across the TMS and FO product surfaces, including different interfaces for both restaurants and patrons, and premium add-on features.

Coordinate closely with Engineering, Design, QA, CSM/BD, Marketing, Operations, and other stakeholders to align priorities and execution.

Manage Product Backlog, Release Planning, Sprint Planning, and Scrum execution.

Identify project risks, resolve blockers proactively, and drive teams toward successful delivery, including launch readiness such as internal playbooks and training.

Global Partner Integration

Own the end-to-end partner integration lifecycle: scoping and scenario design, API documentation and testing setup, kickoff, development support, E2E testing, launch, and post-launch operations.

Manage integrations across partner types — booking platforms, POS systems, membership systems, malls and hospitality groups, and regional restaurant groups.

Serve as the primary technical counterpart for global partners across regions and time zones, running kickoff meetings, joint testing, and ongoing technical communication.

Define integration scenarios, acceptance criteria, and success metrics; keep integration projects transparent and on track for internal and external stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management & F&B Insights

Manage intensive, ongoing communication across internal stakeholders (leadership, Engineering, Design, QA, Go to Market teams with daily interaction, Marketing) and external stakeholders (partners and key merchant accounts) with often-competing priorities.

Develop a deep understanding of restaurant front-of-house operations: reservations as inventory management and capacity planning, reservations as a key patron touchpoint, table management, queuing, no-show and revenue assurance/deposit policies, and online food ordering workflows — and represent the merchant's voices in product decisions.

Translate merchant and partner feedback into clear pain point statements and roadmap inputs.

Support multinational delivery with customers in seven highly differentiated markets, including localization and market-specific requirements across regions such as TW, HK, JP, SEA, and ANZ.

 

Requirements

Required

5+ years of Technical Product Management, Technical Program Management, or related experience.

Experience building B2B or B2B2C SaaS software ; vertical SaaS for F&B, restaurants, or hospitality is a strong plus.

Deep F&B industry knowledge, especially restaurant front-of-house operations: reservation and table management, queuing, deposits/no-show handling, POS, or food ordering.

Hands-on experience with adding new third-party integrations And expanding upon existing third-party Integrations — REST APIs, Webhooks, API key/staging environment management, data licensing compliance automation, and end-to-end testing with external partner engineering teams.

Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving alignment across executives, cross-functional teams, and external partners.

Ability to work closely with Engineering to evaluate technical feasibility, development effort, and resource planning.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Excellent cross-functional communication and program management skills; able to work in English with global partners.

 

Preferred

Experience working directly with engineers designers in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred:

Online payment systems, including payment gateways (e.g. Stripe, TapPay), digital wallets (Apple Pay, AliPay, WeChat Pay), deposits/prepayment flows, or subscription billing.

Omnichannel messaging or Omnichannel CRM systems (e.g. Intercom, Twilio Flex, Zendesk, etc)

Global Distribution Systems (GDS) used by airlines or hotels to create and manage priced booking inventory that is published to OTA services (e.g. Amadeus, Travelport, Sabre, or Siteminder, Opera, Cendyn, Shiji, etc)

Booking channel integrations, such as Reserve with Google, channel managers, or OTA/booking platform ecosystems.

POS or hospitality tech ecosystems, including KDS, kiosk, or in-store hardware-adjacent products.

Multi-market product delivery, including multi-language support and market-specific compliance or operational requirements.

Experience working with Product Analytics and data-driven prioritization.

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

  • The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions. You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks.

Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams, and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance.

  • Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder

  • Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases.

  • Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements.

  • Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently.

  • Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments.

  • Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders.

  • Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages).

  • Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems.

  • Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication.

  • Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.

 

Our core principles

  • Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success.

  • Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution.

  • Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn.

  • Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs.

  • Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. description:
Founded in 2005, Diabolocom is a leading European provider of AI-first, cloud-based contact centre (CCaaS) and customer experience (CX) solutions. We combine proprietary AI technology, native telecom infrastructure, and deep CRM integrations to help businesses deliver smarter, more seamless customer experiences.

Trusted by over 400 clients, we are entering a new phase of growth, scaling our technology and accelerating our international expansion, with offices in the United States, Canada, Brazil, and the United Arab Emirates.

Our ambition is to become a global technology leader by combining engineering excellence, continuous innovation, and long-term vision. At Diabolocom, you'll contribute to impactful products in a growing international company that remains agile enough for your ideas and contributions to make a real difference.

About the Role

As part of our Cross Functional Projects team, you will work on a variety of technical and business-driven projects with a direct impact on Diabolocom's operations and growth.

You'll join a hands-on team tackling important business challenges, where pragmatism, autonomy, and fast execution are key. From developing applications and internal tools to contributing to cross-functional initiatives, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, explore different technical challenges, and see your solutions make a tangible difference.

If you enjoy building high-quality software, taking initiative, and working in a dynamic environment where you can have a real impact, this role is for you.

Your Responsibilities

Software Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable web applications and APIs using React, Node.js (Express), PostgreSQL, and Sequelize.

  • Ensure high code quality and maintainability, and contribute to managing our codebase within a monorepo architecture.

Strategic Projects

  • Partner with a cross-functional project manager and collaborate with teams across Operations, Product, and IT to deliver strategic projects.

  • Contribute throughout the entire project lifecycle, from initial scoping and design to development, deployment, and post-production support.

Tooling & Infrastructure

  • Enhance internal tools to improve workflows and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate on DevOps initiatives, with a focus on CI/CD, deployment automation, and orchestration using Kubernetes and Helm.

About You

Your Experience & Technical Skills

  • You have around 3 years of experience in software development. Relevant apprenticeship experience is also welcome.

  • You have experience building and maintaining web applications and APIs.

  • You are comfortable with back-end development, particularly Node.js and Express, and have experience working with PostgreSQL and Sequelize.

  • You have knowledge of React and modern web application architectures.

  • You care about code quality, maintainability, and following sound development practices.

  • Familiarity with monorepo architectures, CI/CD, Kubernetes, and Helm is a plus.

Your Mindset

  • Autonomous: You can take ownership of your work and move projects forward independently.

  • Proactive: You identify opportunities for improvement and are comfortable suggesting and implementing solutions.

  • Pragmatic: You focus on practical, effective solutions and know how to balance technical quality with delivery speed.

  • Curious and adaptable: You enjoy tackling different technical challenges and learning new tools and technologies.

  • Collaborative: You work well with others and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Committed: You are engaged in your work, take responsibility for your deliverables, and contribute positively to the team.

Here is what you'll enjoy at Diabolocom:

  • Join us at a pivotal stage of growth: contribute to a fast-growing technology company with ambitious international expansion plans and opportunities to develop your skills and career.

  • Make a tangible impact: work in a lean team where your ideas, technical decisions, and contributions can make a real difference.

  • Take ownership: get involved in meaningful projects from initial requirements to production, with room to take initiative and grow your responsibilities.

  • Grow your expertise: benefit from comprehensive onboarding to develop a deep understanding of our products, technologies, and business.

  • Work in an international environment: collaborate with teams across a growing global organisation.

  • Enjoy a great workplace: our office is located in the heart of Paris, just 100 metres from Opéra Garnier.

  • Get the right tools for the job: choose your preferred IT equipment to work efficiently.

PAUL macht Bestandsgebäude fit für eine klimaneutrale Zukunft.
